verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs endpoint (doc.md) that points agents to the full documentation index. First-party docs add a 'Build with AI' guide for preparing agents and an official agent-skills repo, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent community reports of agents actually using the llms.txt/markdown docs in practice.
